title: Turkish Reciprocal Verb Form (-iş)
summary: Expressing mutual or reciprocal actions ('each other').
explanation: Attach '-iş/-ış/-uş/-üş' to verb stems to indicate actions performed mutually or together (e.g., görüşmek = to meet/see each other).

example_translations.ex_trrec_1: We met with our friend yesterday.

common_error_explanations.err_trrec_1: Use reciprocal suffixes for mutual actions.
